cities.name: Tallinn
interests: Medieval Old Town 🎭 — Cobblestones, ancient walls, merchant houses and gothic church towers.
Seaside & Harbor Walks 🌊 — Baltic breezes, promenades and long coastlines.
Art & Museums 🎨 — Modern galleries, history exhibits and design spaces.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Palace gardens, forest pockets and urban green corners.
Local Food Exploration 😋 — Warm soups, potato dishes, rye bread and Baltic pastries.
cities.local_food_tip: Warm Estonian soups, potato dishes, veggie stews, rye bread, cakes and pastries — cozy Baltic comfort food full of simple, clean flavors.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Tallinna vanalinn (Tallinn Old Town): Medieval towers, narrow alleys and fairytale colors. → 🏛️ Raekoja plats (Town Hall Square): Gothic architecture & open square charm. → ☕ Cozy Old Town café for cinnamon pastries. Afternoon: 🌊 Walk the coastal path toward Pirita rannapromenaad (Pirita Seaside Promenade): long Baltic coastline + fresh sea air. → 🌿 Stroll through Kadrioru park (Kadriorg Park): ponds, sculptures and palace gardens. → 🎨 Exterior visit of Kumu kunstimuuseum (Kumu Art Museum). → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie soups, salads and potato dishes. Sunset: 🌅 Patkuli vaateplatvorm (Patkuli Viewing Platform): Old Town roofs glowing at golden hour. Night: 🌃 Lantern-lit Old Town streets: dessert cafés, medieval charm and soft lights.

ideas: 🚶‍♂️ Quiet morning walks in vanalinn’s narrow alleys.
☕ Outdoor terraces opening for warm drinks.
🌊 Long seaside walks along Pirita promenade.
🥧 Warm pastries in Old Town cafés.
🎨 Museum afternoons at Kumu during windy days.
🏰 Fairy lights along old city walls.

public_transport_tips: 🚋 Trams connect the city center with Kadriorg and coastal districts.
🚌 Buses cover suburbs and all major neighborhoods.
🚶 Vanalinn is best explored entirely on foot.
🚲 Bike paths exist along the waterfront and parks.
📱 Use the 'Tallinna Transport' or 'Ühiskaart' system for tickets.

city_events.description: 🎭 Medieval shows, crafts, music and performances in the Old Town.

city_events.name: Kadrioru valgusfestival (Kadriorg Light Festival)
city_events.description: ✨ Illuminated park paths, art lights and evening strolls.

city_events.name: Tallinn Christmas Market
city_events.description: 🎄 Iconic European-style holiday market on Town Hall Square.

cities.name: Haapsalu
interests: Seaside Views 🌊 — Calm coastal breezes and wide promenades.
Historic Streets 🎭 — Wooden houses, castle grounds and old-town corners.
Nature & Lakes 🌿 — Bayside paths and soft landscapes.
cities.local_food_tip: Light Baltic meals like veggie soups, salads, rye bread and pastries — mild, fresh flavors perfect for a seaside town.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🌊 Walk the Haapsalu promenaad (Seaside Promenade): quiet, beautiful waterfront. → 🏰 Exterior of Haapsalu piiskopilinnus (Haapsalu Castle). → ☕ Lakeside café. Afternoon: 🏘️ Explore Old Town wooden houses. → 🌿 Walk around Haapsalu laht (Haapsalu Bay). → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie soups, salads, potato dishes. → 🎨 Artisan shops & local crafts. Sunset: 🌅 Promenade glowing over calm water. Night: 🌃 Quiet waterfront lights + dessert or warm drink.

ideas: 🕊 Migratory birds returning to Haapsalu Bay.
🌊 Long promenade walks with Baltic breeze.
🍦 Ice cream stands by the water.
🌇 Soft pink sunsets across the bay.
🎶 Open-air events by the castle lawn.
🌞 Crisp seaside air and minimal crowds.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Direct buses connect Haapsalu with Tallinn.
🚶 Town center is compact and fully walkable.
🚲 Perfect for bicycles in spring and summer.
📱 Use 'LuxExpress' or 'Tpilet' for regional connections.

city_events.name: Valge Daami festival (White Lady Festival)
city_events.description: 🎭 Theatre, lights and cultural performances by the castle.

city_events.name: Haapsalu Õudusfilmide Festival (Horror Film Festival)
city_events.description: 🎬 Unique film event with spooky charm.

cities.name: Narva
interests: Historic Fortresses 🏛️ — Massive walls, towers and border history.
Riverside Views 🌊 — Dramatic scenery along the Narva River.
Urban Culture 🎭 — Industrial heritage mixed with modern touches.
cities.local_food_tip: Warm eastern-style soups, potato meals, salads, rye bread and pastries — hearty Baltic comfort food.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Explore Narva kindlus (Narva Castle) from the exterior: dramatic views of the river and Ivangorod Fortress across the border. → 🌊 Walk the Narva jõe promenaad (River Promenade). → ☕ Riverside café. Afternoon: 🌉 More riverside paths and viewpoints. → 🏘️ Old streets near the castle. → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie soups, potato dishes, fresh salads. → 🎨 Explore creative urban corners and murals. Sunset: 🌅 Castle silhouettes glowing across the river. Night: 🌃 Quiet evening walk along the water.

ideas: 📸 Clear sky photography near Narva Castle.
🌊 Breezy promenades with long river views.
🍦 Ice cream stops near the fortress.
🌇 Long golden evenings over the border river.
🎨 Museum or gallery visits on cold days.
🌫 Misty castle views — moody and dramatic.
🌞 Soft river light and snowy castle landscapes.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Trains from Tallinn to Narva are frequent and comfortable.
🚌 Local buses run along major streets and the riverfront.
🚶 Many key landmarks are close and walkable.
📱 Use the 'Elron' app for train tickets & schedules.

city_events.name: Narva Ooperipäevad (Narva Opera Days)
city_events.description: 🎶 Open-air opera performances near the castle walls.

city_events.name: Narva Linnapäevad (City Days)
city_events.description: 🎭 Local culture, concerts and outdoor gatherings.

cities.name: Pärnu
interests: Beaches & Sea Views 🌊 — Long sandy shores and calm waters.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Spacious green areas near the sea.
Old Town Culture 🎭 — Pastel houses, cafés and Baltic charm.
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh salads, veggie bowls, soups and pastries — perfect for a seaside city with a light summer vibe.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏖️ Walk along Pärnu rand (Pärnu Beach): soft sand, gentle waves. → 🌿 Explore Rannapark (Beach Park). → ☕ Seaside café. Afternoon: 🏘️ Wander Pärnu vanalinn (Old Town) streets. → 🌳 Walk along Pärnu jõgi (Pärnu River). → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie bowls, salads, potato dishes. → 🎨 Small art spaces or craft corners. Sunset: 🌅 Wide horizon glowing at Pärnu Beach. Night: 🌃 Seaside lights and dessert stands.

ideas: 🏖️ Warm beach days with family-friendly vibe.
🍉 Fresh fruit stands near the coast.
🌞 Crisp air and peaceful beach paths.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Frequent buses from Tallinn to Pärnu.
🚶 Beach and center are easy to explore on foot.
🚲 Great for biking in warm seasons.
📱 Use 'Tpilet' for regional bus schedules and tickets.

city_events.name: Pärnu Muusikafestival (Pärnu Music Festival)
city_events.description: 🎶 Major classical music festival with international artists.

cities.name: Rakvere
interests: Castles & Landmarks 🏛️ — Hilltop fortress with dramatic views.
Parks & Nature 🌿 — Forest paths and open-air viewpoints.
Small-Town Culture 🎭 — Relaxed streets and quiet Baltic charm.
cities.local_food_tip: Simple Baltic comfort dishes — potato meals, veggie soups, rye bread and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Visit Rakvere linnus (Rakvere Castle) from the outside: hilltop views & medieval silhouettes. → 🌿 Park pathways near the castle. → ☕ Local café. Afternoon: 🏘️ Explore Rakvere Old Town. → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie soups, salads, warm dishes. → 🎨 Art corners and small galleries. Sunset: 🌅 Hilltop glow over Rakvere Castle. Night: 🌃 Quiet lantern-lit streets.

ideas: 🌞 Soft light on snowy castle walls.

public_transport_tips: 🚆 Frequent Elron trains from Tallinn.
🚶 Castle & center easily walkable.
🚌 Local buses run hourly to neighborhoods.
📱 Use 'Elron' app for trains.

cities.name: Tartu
interests: Old Town & University Streets 🎭 — Pastel houses, academic vibe and cobbled lanes.
Museums & Culture 🎨 — Galleries, science centers and art spaces.
Parks & River Walks 🌿 — Riverbanks, green hills and open squares.
cities.local_food_tip: Fresh Baltic-style salads, soups, veggie stews and pastries — youthful, vibrant and cozy.
cities.full_day: Morning: 🏛️ Walk around Tartu Ülikool (University of Tartu) exterior: classic white columns. → 🏘️ Explore Tartu Old Town. → ☕ Student-friendly café. Afternoon: 🌿 Stroll along Emajõgi jõgi (Emajõgi River). → 🎨 Exterior stop at Tartu Kunstimuuseum (Art Museum). → 🍽️ Lunch: veggie bowls, soups, salads. → 🏞️ Walk through Toome mägi (Dome Hill Park). Sunset: 🌅 River reflections. Night: 🌃 Dessert cafés & warm lights in Old Town.

ideas: 🌇 Warm golden evenings along the park areas.
🎨 Art museum visits on cold days.
🎄 Festive Old Town lights and markets.

public_transport_tips: 🚌 Tartu has an easy bus network used heavily by students.
🚲 Extremely bike-friendly, especially in warm seasons.
🚶 Old Town and university areas are very walkable.
📱 Use the 'Tartu Transport' app for routes and tickets.

city_events.name: Tartu Tudengipäevad (Student Days)
city_events.description: 🎉 Festivals, creativity, competitions and youth energy across the city.

city_events.name: Emajõe Summer Nights
city_events.description: 🌊 Music, art and cultural evenings by the river.
